name: Tenstorrent Blackhole p150, tt-metal: Llama-3.1-8B decode tok/s per-user + aggregate (vendor-measured b32)
unit: tok/s per user at batch-32; 1059 tok/s aggregate
methodology: VENDOR-MEASURED in the tenstorrent/tt-metal model matrix. Batch-32 decode, ISL=128. Llama-3.1-8B on Blackhole p150: 33.1 t/s/u and 1059 t/s AGGREGATE; the row is marked '*' = Blackhole software under active development. 2x p150 DP: 1190 t/s. 32 GB GDDR6 at 512 GB/s lets it hold bigger models than the n150's 12 GB.
notes: The strongest single-card answer in the Tenstorrent lineup. p150a/b $1,399 / p100a $999 NEW. Llama-3.1-8B is 'Experimental' on the single p150 card but 'Complete' on multi-card/QuietBox configs - the software is still maturing. Buy Wormhole or Blackhole for the open stack; do NOT buy the legacy Grayskull for LLM (no current LLM demos in tt-metal).
